title: Fluence Energy fiscal Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At March 31, 2026, cash and restricted cash were USD 412.9 million, convertible notes were USD 391.7 million, and six-month operating cash outflow was USD 347.9 million.
summary: The quarterly filing supplies current balance-sheet, cash-flow, economic-share-count, revenue, margin, concentration and backlog-quality evidence for the security assessment.
